description: This file defines a static utility class 'SyntaxFactoryUtility' within the 'Orleans.CodeGenerator.SyntaxGeneration' namespace. It provides extension methods and helper functions for constructing and manipulating C# syntax trees using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis APIs, specifically for member access expressions, generic type names, and class declaration modifications with type parameters and constraints.

classes.name: SyntaxFactoryUtility
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods and helpers for constructing C# syntax trees, including member access, generic names, and class type parameters with constraints.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, string)
methods.description: Creates a member access expression syntax node from an expression and a member name string.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, IdentifierNameSyntax)
methods.description: Creates a member access expression syntax node from an expression and an identifier name syntax node.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, GenericNameSyntax)
methods.description: Creates a member access expression syntax node from an expression and a generic name syntax node.

methods.name: Member (ExpressionSyntax, string, params TypeSyntax[])
methods.description: Creates a member access expression with optional generic type arguments.

methods.name: ToGenericName
methods.description: Converts a string identifier to a GenericNameSyntax.

methods.name: AddGenericTypeParameters
methods.description: Adds generic type parameters and constraints to a class declaration syntax node.

methods.name: GetTypeParameterConstraints
methods.description: Generates a list of constraints for each type parameter based on its symbol constraints.
